scope: Natural indoor node crowding and shared buddy selection; not whole CQB/LAMBS parity
comparisonLimit: Existing review distinguishes active assault from legacy random-progress helpers; no new compiled LAMBS callgraph or physical comparison established here.

findings.before: IndoorActorNodeSelect filtered requested reservations and temporary node failures, but not another current squad body at the selected point.
findings.change: Snapshot at most16 living/simulated/visible/on-foot same-group actors and exclude node proximity within1.5m horizontal/1m vertical before ranking. No other-group/enemy/world scan, persistent occupancy record or failed-node credit.

findings.before: CombatPairs preserved intact pairs but assigned orphan/new partners from the front of the remaining roster.
findings.change: Preserve intact pairs first, then select nearest eligible remaining partner by3D distance, stable roster ties. Metadata only; no new movement or actor ownership.

limits: Geometric proximity does not prove connectivity around walls or stairs.
Node crowding margin is conservative, not an exact collision or room partition model.
Candidate occupancy can change after planning; native collision and command-boundary authority remain required.
Cross-group crowding and unseen enemies are deliberately not sampled.
Explicit building-clearance lanes, exterior isolation, post-clear settlement and stragglers remain separate acceptance requirements.
No physical or 5% median/10% p95 performance acceptance.
